_about: Clips for scripts/grade.mjs. 'file' is a fragment of an .mp4 file name, searched in clips/ (the Drive set, see clips/README.md) then test_videos/ (neither is committed); 'synthetic' is a scene drawn by src/grader/synthetic.ts (no file needed); 'iris' is an EA IRIS test video from node scripts/iris/fetch.mjs. kind: calm = no flashing here, the filter should change nothing; strobe = flashing that must be damped. start/seconds were picked from a brightness-jump scan of the Drive set (see the comments below).

clips.name: syn-red-full
clips._note: saturated red strobe, whole frame, 5 Hz

clips.name: syn-red-area
clips._note: red strobe over ~35% of the frame, 4 Hz

clips.name: syn-small-flash
clips._note: white strobe over exactly 6 of 48 cells (12.5%, under the 25% rule)

clips.name: syn-small-unaligned
clips._note: ~15% straddling cell edges: the detector over-counts it as 25%+

clips.name: syn-area-30
clips._note: white strobe over ~30% (just over the 25% rule)

clips.name: syn-caution
clips._note: full-frame flash at 2.5 Hz (2–3 Hz band)

clips.name: syn-dark-strobe
clips._note: bright strobe over a dim, detailed scene (veil test)

clips.name: syn-mixed
clips._note: calm half beside flashing lasers (collateral test)
